title: CHAF1A identified as a candidate biomarker and potential therapeutic target in Burkitt lymphoma through integrated bioinformatics and histopathological analysis.
snippet: Burkitt lymphoma (BL) is a highly aggressive malignancy with limited effective treatments due to toxicity/resistance. Identifying and prioritizing candidate biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets from complex transcriptomic data, ahead of functional validation, remains a major unmet need.
